prompt: Create a square digital illustration of a chubby golden Syrian hamster doing the “talk to the hand / stop” gesture, with one small pink paw raised upright beside its face like a human palm. The hamster has warm golden orange and creamy white fur, a rounded oversized body, fluffy cheek and belly fur, small rounded ears with darker inner shading, glossy narrow black eyes angled in a stern unimpressed expression, a tiny pink nose, fine white whiskers, and a slightly downturned mouth. Pose it in a three-quarter front view, leaning slightly forward, with the raised paw on the viewer’s right and the other paw hanging low. Use detailed soft anime-style rendering with visible fur strokes, gentle painterly shading, clean dark linework, and a cute-but-serious comedic mood. Place the character large in frame, cropped close so the body fills most of the square canvas, against a simple flat bright warm yellow background with no props, no text, and no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张方形数字插画，描绘一只胖乎乎的叙利亚金丝熊仓鼠做出“拒绝/停止”的手势，一只粉色小爪子竖在脸旁，如同人类的手掌。这只仓鼠拥有 暖金橙色和奶油白色 的毛发，身体圆润肥大，脸颊和腹部毛发蓬松，小巧圆润的耳朵带有较深的内部阴影，光亮狭长的黑色眼睛呈现出严肃且不以为然的表情，有着小巧的粉色鼻子、细长的白色胡须以及微微下垂的嘴巴。采用四分之三正面视角，身体略微前倾，举起的手爪位于观察者的右侧，另一只爪子自然下垂。使用细腻的柔和动漫风格渲染，呈现出可见的毛发纹理、柔和的绘画感阴影、清晰的深色线条，营造出一种可爱又严肃的喜剧氛围。角色在画面中占比很大，近距离裁剪使身体填满大部分方形画布，背景为简洁平面的 明亮暖黄色，无道具、无文字、无水印。
